mechanism: Coenzyme Q10 may potentiate the antiplatelet effects of NSAIDs like piroxicam, increasing bleeding risk, while piroxicam may reduce CoQ10 levels through inhibition of HMG-CoA reductase pathway enzymes.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding; consider alternative analgesia if high bleeding risk exists; counsel patients on bleeding precautions and discuss benefit-risk ratio of concurrent use.
